about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: She Global Furry Television (GFTV) yn chanel naight smoo ayns yn Aishey son y fandom furry, as t’eh soit ayns Singapore.
about.body-2: Ta shin soilshaghey kys ta’n theay furry gaase, son dy vod dy chooilley pheiagh soiaghey jeh jiu as mairagh, as ta shin croo boayllyn raad oddys sleih enney y gheddyn er as toiggal y cheilley.
about.body-3: Er-skeayley harrish yn seihll veih’n thie, ta sheshaght GFTV eddyr-ashoonagh, lesh ymmodee cultooryn as ymmodee çhengaghyn.
